title: Add append-only recovery for convergence receipt hash mismatch
objective: Preserve immutable convergence evidence while allowing one narrowly-scoped append-only correction when an otherwise semantically identical MISSION_CONVERGENCE_RECEIPT_v1 has only an invalid declared receipt_sha256. Add a versioned supersession sidecar under the existing append-only convergence evidence root, validate that the original receipt remains unchanged, require semantic identity except receipt_sha256, reject ambiguous or broader replacements, and let the existing convergence-aware post-fix verifier consume the correction without weakening append-only history.

evidence.summary: Landed append-only convergence receipt has complete SATISFIED coverage but an incorrect declared receipt_sha256.
All configured adversarial runtime machine predicates passed; only MISSION_CONVERGENCE_REQUIRED remained.
In-place one-line correction was correctly rejected by APPEND_ONLY_EVIDENCE_VIOLATION.
Correct canonical hash excluding receipt_sha256; existing declared value differs.
v1 candidate was rejected only for FORBIDDEN_BOUNDARY_INCOMPLETE; v2 adds the canonical missing 'new policy semantics' prohibition.

forbidden_changes: modifying or deleting any existing file under research/codex/convergence/
accepting semantic changes to objective, requirements, coverage, evidence, gaps, authority, candidate binding, PR binding or merge binding
accepting a supersession when the original receipt is already valid
accepting more than one applicable correction for the same base receipt
reproduction: On fresh main, run the convergence-aware post-fix verifier for codex-research-alpha-adversarial-runtime-wiring-v1. All configured JSON predicates pass but MISSION_CONVERGENCE_REQUIRED remains. The canonical hash of the landed convergence receipt excluding receipt_sha256 is 8d2f0fdcebcfb3524eafbdd906c59b7d5a05ece42ebc91ac8c0225b5eb8e8dac while the declared hash differs. PR #1430 demonstrates that modifying the landed receipt violates append-only evidence.

positive: An invalid-hash-only base convergence receipt plus exactly one valid append-only supersession sidecar whose corrected receipt differs only in receipt_sha256 is accepted by validate_receipt.
The historical base convergence receipt remains byte-identical and append-only governance passes because recovery adds only a new sidecar.

The specific adversarial-runtime convergence receipt becomes valid through the sidecar and the existing post-fix verifier can materialize its normal completion receipt without Alpha-specific special casing.
negative: A supersession that changes any field other than receipt_sha256 is rejected.
A supersession is rejected when the base receipt is already valid.
Zero or multiple applicable supersessions for an invalid base receipt fail closed.
A supersession with mismatched candidate_id, signature, candidate hash, task-contract hash, PR number or merge SHA is rejected.
The recovery path cannot modify or delete protected evidence and cannot bypass append-only governance.

clean_noop_condition: Fresh main already supports append-only invalid-hash-only convergence correction without modifying historical convergence evidence, and the adversarial runtime task no longer fails solely on the bad declared hash.
stop_condition: Stop without code changes if an existing sanctioned recovery path resolves the exact case or if a safe fix would require arbitrary semantic receipt replacement or weakening append-only evidence.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if recovery cannot be limited to invalid-hash-only semantic identity or requires changing market, portfolio, API-budget, Alpha or canonical authority semantics.
rollback_plan: Revert only validator/test support for the supersession contract. Preserve the historical invalid receipt and every supersession sidecar as immutable audit evidence.
